snippet.title: My NEET Life (2026) - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
My NEET Life is coming soon to STEAM, baby!

Step into the shoes of Akiko Amaya (Lynn Ashwood) as she navigates a rocky road full of odd jobs and well, life experience in this short, zany anime-style video game!

With the help of Ryu Shoto, a clever but struggling business woman - she must learn to get back on her feet and start socialising again... or risk being a forever NEET.

**How you spend your time is up to you — will you keep coasting or finally break free?**
